purpose: English and Russian phrases for the repository integration operator.

interpretation.multiple_aliases: Map synonyms to their canonical action. Run each requested action once; synonyms must not trigger duplicate work.
interpretation.force: Treat force as a priority request. It never allows required reviews, CI, security checks or branch protection to be skipped.
interpretation.push: Publish to the requested feature branch or another explicitly approved ref. Never push directly to a protected branch.
interpretation.merge: Merge a pull request only after its required reviews and checks have passed.
interpretation.execute: Start the operation that has already been identified and validated. Do not widen its scope.
interpretation.scope: Work only in repositories and branches named in the request or included in the approved repository inventory.

force_push_allowed_only_when: The request names one specific, non-protected feature branch.
The current remote head SHA has been read and is used as the exact --force-with-lease expectation.
A backup ref exists and the commits that would be displaced have been reviewed.
No required review, check, security rule or repository policy is bypassed.
safeguards.merge_method: Use a method enabled by the repository. Prefer squash when repository policy allows it.
safeguards.dependency_order: Integrate shared changes in dependency order, from providers to consumers.
safeguards.audit: Record the PR, source and target refs, checks, review state, merge method, resulting commit SHA and outcome.

agent_identity.note: The assistant is not a GitHub account. Unattended automation needs a dedicated GitHub App or service account with only the permissions it needs. Do not grant ruleset-bypass permissions.
